name: First steps
beschreibung: A small practice project: go through the whole flow once – give an instruction, start the AI, answer a question, look at the result. The project folder is in the fabBoard data folder under “beispiele”.

items.titel: 1. There is already an instruction for the AI at the top
items.text: Under “To …” you will find an open message: the AI should create a file hello.txt. You write your own instructions in the same field.

The AI reads your instruction but does not change anything yet. It asks you questions on the board, for example what should go into the file. This usually takes a minute or two; the button pulses meanwhile. “Follow” shows what it is doing right now.

items.titel: 3. Answer the question and start again
items.text: Pick an answer to the new question and start the AI again. Only now does it create the file hello.txt. This way you always decide what the AI may do.

nachrichten.text: Create the file hello.txt with a greeting in the project folder.
